newsitem.title: USA: CAIB to advise on C.Europe infrastructure plans.
newsitem.headline: CAIB to advise on C.Europe infrastructure plans.

text.p: Creditanstalt Investment Bank (CAIB) has set up a company to advise would-be investors interested in infrastructure projects in central and eastern Europe, the bank said in a statement.
The Vienna-datelined statement said the new company, CAIB Infrastructure Project Advisors, already had agreed and pending transaction volumes worth a total of $4.5 billion.
"We are anticipating a boom in infrastructure finance in central and eastern Europe," CAIB deputy chairman Heinrich Pecina said.
"We expect the market to grow to become a $5-10 billion business annually within the next seven to 10 years and estimate that CAIB will have at least a 20 percent share."
CAIB said the new unit would be based in London and Vienna and would offer comprehensive advice on bidding, financial structuring and debt and equity placement in central and eastern Europe.
